content.title: Are banks open on Good Friday? Does mail run? What's open, closed for Easter 2026
content.text: April 3, 2026, 4:46 a.m. CTGood Friday is not a federal holiday, but many offices, stores and federal services may close or adjust hours to allow employees to spend time with their families.Good Friday when the Christian faith commemorates the crucifixion and death of Jesus Christ. "From the early days of Christianity, Good Friday was observed as a day of sorrow, penance, and fasting," according to Britannica.Easter falls on Sunday, April 5, this year, and it celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ and follows a 40-day period known as Lent. The date the holidays are celebrated changes depending on the year because Easter is one of several "moveable feasts" in the liturgical year, according to the History Channel. Other examples of "moveable feasts" include Ash Wednesday and Palm Sunday.Here's what's open and what's closed on Good Friday and Easter Sunday.More: Same Easter budget buys 40% less candy in 2026, data showsIs the post office open on Good Friday? Will mail be delivered?U.S. Postal Service facilities will have normal operations on Friday, April 3, meaning USPS facilities will be open for retail transactions and mail will be delivered as usual, according to the USPS website.Will FedEx and UPS deliver on Good Friday, Easter Sunday?FedEx will be operating under modified service on Good Friday and will be closed on Easter Sunday. It will operate under regular hours on Holy Saturday.UPS will be open on Good Friday and closed on Easter Sunday.Will banks be open on Good Friday?Most major banks in Oklahoma should be open on Good Friday but closed on Easter Sunday, as most banks are typically closed on Sundays.ATMs and online and mobile banking features should still be accessible. However, some transactions may not process until the next business day.Banks will reopen on Monday.More: Aaliyah Chavez 'learned a lot' in whirlwind first OU women's basketball seasonAre markets closed on Good Friday?The New York Stock Exchange, Nasdaq and bond markets are regularly closed on Sundays, but will also be closed to observe Good Friday.Is Good Friday a federal holiday?No, Good Friday is not a federal holiday in the U.S., so federal services should be open as normal. This is the same case for Oklahoma state government services and the City of Oklahoma City.However, Good Friday is an observed holiday in Oklahoma County, so county offices and the courthouse will be closed on Friday, April 3.When is Good Friday 2026?This year, Good Friday will be on Friday, April 3, 2026.When is Easter 2026?This year, Easter Sunday will be on Sunday, April 5, 2026.Is Easter Sunday a federal holiday? Do we get the day off?Easter Sunday is not a federal holiday, but most federal workers and many private employees have the day off because the holiday falls on the weekend.More: Severe thunderstorms, wildfires expected in Oklahoma this week: Latest forecastOKC trash schedule: Is there garbage pickup on Easter Sunday?Garbage pickup will be unaffected on Easter Sunday, as there is regularly no pickup collection on Sundays.What public transit will be available in OKC on Easter Sunday?Public transit is unaffected in OKC on Easter Sunday.More: Drew Svoboda building Oklahoma State football tight end group in search of 'true hybrid'Will schools be open on Good Friday?Most schools in the Oklahoma City metro will operate as usual on Good Friday.Will restaurants and stores be open on Easter Sunday? Target and Costco will be closed, Walmart openMany major retailers, such as Target, Sam's Club and Costco, will be closed on April 5 to observe Easter Sunday. Other stores that will be closed on Sunday include Lowe's, Aldi, Burlington, TJ Maxx and Best Buy.But not all stores will be closed. Grocery stores like Walmart, Trader Joe's and Whole Foods, as well as CVS and Walgreens pharmacies, should remain open. Fast food and chain restaurants are also likely to remain open, though local restaurants could be closed, depending on location.Isa Almeida is a trending reporter for The Oklahoman.
